title: My Amazing Body
subject: Integrated Studies
description: Your brain, heart, muscles, and bones work as a team!
steps: Your BRAIN is the boss of your body — it tells every part what to do.
Your HEART is a muscle that pumps blood all around your body, all day and night.
Your BONES (skeleton) hold you up and protect soft parts — like your ribs protect your heart!
Your MUSCLES pull on your bones so you can run, jump, and play.

questions.prompt: Which body part is the 'boss' that tells the others what to do?

questions.hint: It beats all day and night!

questions.prompt: What do your bones do? Pick ALL the right answers!
questions.hint: Think about your skeleton's two big jobs.

questions.prompt: What pulls on your bones so you can move?
questions.hint: They get stronger when you exercise!
